input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 satisfies the warranty checklist at or above the fallback, and in substance reaches most of the preferred position. Services are warranted to be performed "in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel, in accordance with industry standards" with no time limitation, and Services and Deliverables are warranted to "materially conform to their documentation and agreed specifications" (19.1). The hosted software (which is the "Services" under the definition in 1.8) is warranted to conform "throughout the subscription term", and Deliverables for ninety days after the later of delivery or acceptance (19.2) — comfortably beyond the 90-day software / 30-day services fallback floors. Section 19.4 supplies the required remedies: prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, and, if Vendor cannot cure, termination of the affected item with a refund of Fees paid. Section 19.3 adds the preferred no-malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance warranties, and the disclaimer in 19.5 is expressly limited to implied warranties and states that "No disclaimer limits an express warranty", so it does not hollow out the express warranties. The only shortfall against the preferred wording is that the standalone Deliverable conformance period is 90 days rather than 12 months; Deliverables here are reports, configurations and similar work product rather than licensed software, and the hosted software is covered for the whole term, so this is noted rather than redlined. No redline proposed.
